en.page_title: ERP, Inventory & E-Commerce Projects - Bowei Xu
en.page_description: Software projects by Bowei Xu: an internal operations platform (ERP/WMS/MES), its warehouse subsystem, and two e-commerce platform migrations.
en.project_1_desc1: Independently ran the company's e-commerce migration from OpenCart 1.5.6.4 to 3.0.3.8, covering 2,000+ SKUs and 70,000+ historical orders, reconciled table by table, with no business interruption.
en.project_1_desc2: Wrote SQL migration scripts for data cleaning, field mapping, and relationship rebuilding across major version differences.
en.project_1_desc3: Rebuilt the storefront templates by hand across the template engine change, working out what each customization depended on in the old engine before reimplementing it. Improved mobile responsiveness in the process.
en.project_1_desc4: Rewrote the store's custom features on 3.0 instead of porting the old code, preserving existing behavior such as standard checkout, the quote-only flow, and per-combination variant pricing and stock, while fixing legacy bugs and adding new functionality.
en.project_2_title: Internal Operations Platform (ERP / WMS / MES) - Fuel Cell Store
en.project_2_desc1: Designed and built the company's internal operations platform as sole developer, replacing a slow, partial VB.NET WinForms desktop system with one web platform covering orders, inventory, materials, production work orders, and shipments.
en.project_2_desc2: Modeled the business in a 50+ table SQL Server schema shared directly with the warehouse subsystem, used by 20 to 30 internal users at the same time; its audit table has passed 1,000,000 rows.
en.project_2_desc3: Built 40+ reports that query live operational data and return in under a second, with no separate analytics stack to build or keep in sync.
en.project_2_desc4: Prevented conflicting edits with work-order locking shared with the warehouse subsystem, and added a unified audit trail recording who changed what across every module.
en.project_2_desc5: Set up scheduled backups and a recovery process that restores the system in minutes.
en.project_3_title: Warehouse & Inventory Subsystem (WMS) - Fuel Cell Store
en.project_3_desc1: Built the warehouse and shop-floor half of the internal operations platform, alongside the ERP: stock, receiving and purchase orders, builds and bills of materials, waste, and physical counts across 2,000+ SKUs.
en.project_3_desc2: Moved shop-floor work to scanning: operator badges, work orders, SKUs, and material lots are all identified by QR code, through either a hardware barcode gun or the browser camera.
en.project_3_desc3: Added a discrepancy lock: when a physical count does not match the database, the SKU is blocked from pulling until the variance is resolved, so a quantity already known to be wrong stops moving.
en.project_3_desc4: Rebuilt the lot-tracked materials subsystem from the ground up on its own database, retiring an unreliable legacy version without putting live inventory at risk.
en.project_3_desc5: Built directly on the ERP's SQL Server schema rather than behind a sync layer, so stock reads and writes are immediate and cannot drift out of step with orders, and stock lookups and inventory reports return in under a second.
en.project_4_title: Multi-Site Shopify Migration - Fuel Cell Store
en.project_4_desc1: Moving the company's three sites to separate Shopify stores. HTEC Education (OpenCart 3) and Fuel Cells Etc (WordPress) are live. Fuel Cell Store, the largest with 2,000+ SKUs on OpenCart 3.0.3.8, comes last.
en.project_4_desc2: Owning the data migration: mapping two OpenCart databases and a WordPress site onto Shopify's data model, then moving products, customers, and order history.
en.project_4_desc3: Using AI-assisted reverse engineering to work out what each undocumented custom module does, then deciding for each one whether to replace it with an app, a native Shopify feature, or a custom build.
en.project_4_desc4: Running each cutover with no downtime: rebuilding the theme, redirecting legacy URLs to keep search rankings, and moving DNS to a new provider with mail records carried over. Next, moving GA4 and Google Ads conversion tracking to Shopify.

zh.page_title: ERP、库存与电商项目 - 徐博伟
zh.page_description: 徐博伟的软件项目：企业内部运营平台（ERP/WMS/MES）及其仓储子系统，以及两次电商平台迁移。
zh.project_1_title: OpenCart 电商平台升级 - Fuel Cell Store
zh.project_1_desc1: 独立完成公司电商平台从 OpenCart 1.5.6.4 升级至 3.0.3.8，覆盖 2,000+ SKU 和 70,000+ 历史订单迁移，逐表对账，业务不中断。
zh.project_1_desc2: 独立编写 SQL 迁移脚本，处理跨版本数据清洗、字段映射和关联关系重建。
zh.project_1_desc3: 跨模板引擎手工逐个重建店面模板，先弄清每处定制在旧引擎里依赖什么，再在新引擎上重新实现。移动端适配在此过程中一并提升。
zh.project_1_desc4: 在 3.0 上重写商城的定制功能，而非移植旧代码，尽量保留原有行为（标准结账、仅报价流程、按规格组合设定的价格和库存），同时修复遗留 bug 并新增功能。
zh.project_2_title: 企业内部运营平台（ERP / WMS / MES） - Fuel Cell Store
zh.project_2_desc1: 作为唯一开发者设计并搭建公司内部运营平台，取代原有又慢又不完整的 VB.NET WinForms 桌面系统，用一个 Web 平台覆盖订单、库存、物料、生产工单和发货全流程。
zh.project_2_desc2: 将业务建模为 50+ 张表的 SQL Server 数据库，与仓储子系统直接共用，支撑 20 到 30 名内部用户同时使用；审计表已超过 100 万行。
zh.project_2_desc3: 开发 40+ 份报表，直接查询实时业务数据，亚秒级返回，无需另建和同步一套分析系统。
zh.project_2_desc4: 用与仓储子系统共享的工单锁防止并发编辑互相覆盖，并建立统一的审计日志，记录每个模块中谁改了什么。
zh.project_2_desc5: 建立定时备份和恢复流程，系统可在几分钟内恢复。
zh.project_3_title: 仓储与库存子系统（WMS） - Fuel Cell Store
zh.project_3_desc1: 搭建内部运营平台中仓储与车间的部分，与 ERP 同属一个平台：覆盖 2,000+ SKU 的库存、收货与采购单、组装与物料清单（BOM）、报废和实物盘点。
zh.project_3_desc2: 把车间作业改为扫码驱动：操作员工牌、工单、SKU 和物料批次全部通过二维码识别，扫码枪和浏览器摄像头两种方式都支持。
zh.project_3_desc3: 加入盘点差异锁定：实物盘点与数据库不一致时，该 SKU 在差异解决前禁止出库，已知有误的数量不再继续流转。
zh.project_3_desc4: 从零重建批次追溯物料子系统，使用独立数据库，在不影响线上库存的前提下退役了不可靠的旧系统。
zh.project_3_desc5: 直接构建在与 ERP 共用的 SQL Server 数据表之上，而非通过同步层对接，库存读写即时生效，不会与订单数据产生偏差，库存查询和报表亚秒级返回。
zh.project_4_title: 多站点 Shopify 迁移 - Fuel Cell Store
zh.project_4_desc1: 把公司的三个网站分别迁移到独立的 Shopify 站点。HTEC Education（原 OpenCart 3）和 Fuel Cells Etc（原 WordPress）已上线。规模最大的 Fuel Cell Store（OpenCart 3.0.3.8，2,000+ SKU）最后迁移。
zh.project_4_desc2: 负责数据迁移：把两个 OpenCart 数据库和一个 WordPress 网站映射到 Shopify 的数据模型，再迁入商品、客户和订单历史。
zh.project_4_desc3: 用 AI 辅助逆向工程还原每个无文档定制模块的实际行为，再逐个决定换成应用、Shopify 原生功能，还是自行开发。
zh.project_4_desc4: 负责各站点不停机切换：重建主题，重定向旧 URL 以保住搜索排名，把 DNS 迁到新的服务商并保留邮件记录。接下来把 GA4 与 Google Ads 转化跟踪迁到 Shopify。
